verdict.rationale: Antigravity's Projects can span multiple folders and repos, for example a frontend and backend repo, and give agents full codebase context. External documents such as Google Drive links, PDFs and Office files appear in a Documents section, so a single workspace built from docs and repos is supported. However, nothing in the evidence shows this workspace being shared across a team as a common source of truth. Projects are described as local agent boundaries with scoped permissions, not multi-user shared spaces. Missing for 10: team sharing or collaboration on Projects, a shared or synced source of truth across team members, admin or team workspace management, independent corroboration.
